description: Representative ECS integration contract. Storage parity and physics semantics are correctness gates; deterministic work plus logical index footprint are first-class evidence while shared-runner elapsed time remains advisory.

scenarios.description: Replay and integrate a deterministic 1,000-entity motion workload through reference, sparse-set, cached-sparse, and archetype-table storage.
correctnessEvidence: deterministic storage-work evidence emitted outside timed repetitions
logical index footprint emitted outside timed repetitions

scenarios.description: Integrate 1,000 positioned entities for 20 rounds while only every fourth entity owns Velocity, exposing sparse component lookup work versus archetype-local motion rows.
correctnessEvidence: equal integrated-entity useful work across storage implementations
archetype integration scans fewer rows than sparse-set
sparse-set performs component lookups while archetype motion columns do not
cached-sparse scans the same participating integration rows as archetype storage
cached-sparse performs zero per-row component lookups
logical index footprint emitted outside timed repetitions

scenarios.description: Replay 512 fully populated entities through eight rounds where half the entities remove and re-add Position or Velocity before integration, exposing structural migration costs.
correctnessEvidence: equal integrated-entity useful work across storage implementations
logical index footprint emitted outside timed repetitions

scenarios.description: Run a bounded physics-backed falling-box integration through reference, sparse-set, cached-sparse, and archetype-table storage.
Run the deterministic material-response room through reference, sparse-set, cached-sparse, and archetype-table storage.
Sparse 96-body material step isolates candidate traversal and must not produce exact contacts.
Dense 64-body material step exercises broad-phase candidates, exact contacts and material response.

operations.description: Integrate once over N positioned entities of which M also own Velocity (the mixed-motion fixture at stride N/M). Counters are measured inside the executed integration loops through apply_measured, not predicted by operation_work; snapshot equality across all four storages is asserted first.

metrics.name: integrated_entities
metrics.notes: Useful work; asserted equal across reference, sparse-set, cached-sparse and archetype.

metrics.name: reference_integration_rows_scanned
metrics.notes: The reference model scans every entity by design; linear in N is the declared contract.

metrics.name: sparse_set_integration_rows_scanned
metrics.notes: Selectivity-aware scan of the smaller component pool.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_integration_rows_scanned
metrics.notes: Cached Position+Velocity query rows; a fallback to scanning all entities fails the constant bound in N.

metrics.name: archetype_integration_rows_scanned
metrics.notes: Motion-table rows; a scan of all tables fails the constant bound in N.

operations.description: After the fixture's warm-up integration, repeat the Position+Velocity query R times with no structural changes. Query maintenance must stay zero and read work must follow returned rows, not stored entities.

repetitions.description: measured query executions R after warm-up

metrics.name: rows_returned
metrics.notes: Integrated rows; asserted equal across all four storages and equal to M x R.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_cache_updates
metrics.notes: Measured row changes made by query refreshes; a hidden full-index rebuild makes this non-zero.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_rows_inspected
metrics.notes: Query rows inspected by cache maintenance, changed or not; a rebuild that rescans rows without changing them makes this non-zero.

metrics.name: archetype_entity_locations_inspected
metrics.notes: Entity-location entries read or written by structural work; repeated reads touch none.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_component_slots_touched
metrics.notes: Component sparse slots touched by structural work; none during repeated reads.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_entity_entries_touched
metrics.notes: Alive-set entries touched; none during repeated reads.

metrics.name: archetype_table_rows_touched
metrics.notes: Table rows moved by structural work; none during repeated reads.

operations.description: Remove and re-add Velocity on C changed entities while every one of the N entities matches Position+Velocity, so any rescan of the unrelated population would be paid in full. Every structural primitive (alive-set and location entries, component sparse-index slots and dense rows, query rows, archetype table rows) reports what it reads or writes; each raw counter is bound constant in N and linear in C, and its per-change normalization is budgeted at the analytic per-change ceiling at every sample.

total_entities.description: positioned and moving entities N, including the changed ones

changed_entities.description: entities that remove and re-add Velocity C

metrics.name: reference_entity_entries_touched
metrics.notes: Reference map entries read or written.

metrics.name: sparse_set_entity_entries_touched
metrics.notes: Alive-set entries read or written.

metrics.name: sparse_set_component_slots_touched
metrics.notes: Component paged sparse-index entries plus dense rows pushed, overwritten, removed or swap-moved, counted inside SparseSet::insert and SparseSet::remove.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_entity_entries_touched
metrics.notes: Alive-set entries read or written.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_component_slots_touched
metrics.notes: Component sparse-index entries and dense rows touched by SparseSet::insert/remove plus the two sparse reads of each query refresh.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_rows_inspected
metrics.notes: Query sparse-index reads and writes plus every query row read, pushed, removed or swap-moved inside MotionQuery::refresh, changed or not.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_cache_updates
metrics.notes: Query rows actually changed (outcome).

metrics.name: archetype_entity_locations_inspected
metrics.notes: Location entries read or written at the location accessors.

metrics.name: archetype_table_rows_touched
metrics.notes: Table rows pushed, overwritten, removed or swap-moved, counted inside the table swap_remove primitives and at each push or overwrite.

metrics.name: archetype_structural_table_transitions
metrics.notes: Table moves (outcome).

metrics.name: sparse_set_sparse_page_descents
metrics.notes: Page-map lookups inside the component PagedSparseIndex; one per access plus one per page release. Tree depth is not counted.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_sparse_page_descents
metrics.notes: Page-map lookups inside the component and query PagedSparseIndex instances.

metrics.name: reference_entity_entries_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(reference_entity_entries_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies reference_entity_entries_touched <= 2 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: sparse_set_entity_entries_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(sparse_set_entity_entries_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies sparse_set_entity_entries_touched <= 2 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: sparse_set_component_slots_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(sparse_set_component_slots_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies sparse_set_component_slots_touched <= 7 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_entity_entries_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(cached_sparse_entity_entries_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies cached_sparse_entity_entries_touched <= 2 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_component_slots_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(cached_sparse_component_slots_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies cached_sparse_component_slots_touched <= 13 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_rows_inspected_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(cached_sparse_query_rows_inspected / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies cached_sparse_query_rows_inspected <= 10 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: cached_sparse_query_cache_updates_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(cached_sparse_query_cache_updates / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies cached_sparse_query_cache_updates <= 3 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: archetype_entity_locations_inspected_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(archetype_entity_locations_inspected / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies archetype_entity_locations_inspected <= 6 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: archetype_table_rows_touched_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(archetype_table_rows_touched / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies archetype_table_rows_touched <= 6 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: archetype_structural_table_transitions_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(archetype_structural_table_transitions / changed_entities); the budget is the analytic per-change ceiling, so every sample satisfies archetype_structural_table_transitions <= 2 * changed_entities.

metrics.name: sparse_set_sparse_page_descents_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(sparse_set_sparse_page_descents / changed_entities): removal <= 3 (remove, release, swap repair) plus insert 2 (lookup, set).

metrics.name: cached_sparse_sparse_page_descents_per_change
metrics.notes: ceil(cached_sparse_sparse_page_descents / changed_entities): component removal 3, leaving refresh 6, moved refresh 3, insert 2, returning refresh 4.

operations.description: Project the full canonical snapshot. Scanning every live entity is legitimate here, so linear growth in N is declared and allowed, unlike the incremental operations above.
